mapper.select: SELECT c.* FROM review_card c JOIN knowledge k ON k.id = c.knowledge_id WHERE k.user_id = #{userId} AND c.next_review_at <= #{now} ORDER BY c.next_review_at ASC, c.id ASC
SELECT c.* FROM review_card c JOIN knowledge k ON k.id = c.knowledge_id WHERE k.user_id = #{userId} AND c.last_reviewed_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY c.last_reviewed_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT c.stage AS stage, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM review_card c JOIN knowledge k ON k.id = c.knowledge_id WHERE k.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY c.stage
SELECT c.knowledge_id AS knowledgeId, MAX(c.stage) AS maxStage, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM review_card c JOIN knowledge k ON k.id = c.knowledge_id WHERE k.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY c.knowledge_id
